state_lunch_notes.Error Message: The total Direct Certification was greater than the count of students reported as Free Lunch Qualified.
state_lunch_notes.State Note: Data shown was submitted by the LEAs and is considered valid as reported. This error is due to the fact that our Direct Certification EUT includes students certified for both free and reduced lunch.

state_lunch_notes.File Name: Directory, CCD School, Free and Reduced Price Lunch, Membership
state_lunch_notes.Error Message: Direct Certification or Free and Reduced-Price Lunch was not reported for a school with membership that has the National School Lunch Program.
state_lunch_notes.State Note: All of the schools listed are PK-only schools.  As such, we do not include their F/R lunch numbers in the data we report.

state_lunch_notes.File Name: Directory, Free and Reduced Price Lunch
state_lunch_notes.Error Message: Free and Reduced Price Lunch was reported for a reportable program.
state_lunch_notes.State Note: Forrest Hills Community Development Center is a site under Fairfield City BOE.  This site houses multiple different school types under one roof, but there is at least one Pre-K class that has Fairfield City board enrolled Pre-K children that should be counted towards CEP numbers.  This is why we have it listed as a CEP site within our CNP Online Application.

state_lunch_notes.Error Message: The count of students reported for Free and Reduced-Price Lunch in the SEA in the current SY varied significantly from the prior SY.
state_lunch_notes.State Note: The data owners have verified that this rule failure is due to the roll back on households eligible for Medicaid.  Beginning April 1, 2025 when we captured our data used to qualify schools for CEP, we noticed a ~6% decrease in directly certified students across the state.
